name: coordination/stage-digest
description: ADR-0016 §4: the staged reference is a function of the CONTENT. The digest is SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of exactly three fields — the payload by its own SHA-256, the recipient label, and the task type — and the reference is 'stage-' plus the first 32 hex characters of that digest. This is what makes staging idempotent on the digest rather than on a client-chosen id: a driver cannot choose the reference, and two stages of the same content cannot disagree about it.
